content.comment_body: I am using a [product_name] PLC with expansion modules. There are five expansion modules in total. The PLC and one expansion module operate correctly, but the others show an orange indicator. What could be causing this issue? The system previously functioned well, but this issue appeared unexpectedly. Thank you for any assistance. Regards, [user_name]

I experienced a similar issue before. For me, the slide contact on the expansion module was not inserted properly. Please check that on your setup. Note: The [product_name] PLC supports only 24 digital inputs and 16 digital outputs, including those from the basic module. You may have too many expansion modules connected.
Hello [user_name], Which module types are showing the orange LED?

analysis.insight_summary: Users identified an orange LED indicator on certain expansion modules connected to a [product_name] PLC, while the main module and one expansion stayed operational. This issue appeared after previous stable performance. Suggestions included checking hardware connections and considering hardware feature limits, but the exact cause remained unclear, prompting peer troubleshooting.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect all connected expansion modules to operate reliably without error indicators and want a clear explanation and solution for the orange LED status.
